name: Two Patrols
hint: Three takes, and the two walkers are dealt with in two different ways. Walker w1 paces x=8..20 and its span contains plate p1 (x=10..12.2); walker w2 paces x=26..34 and its span contains the EXIT itself at x=28. A walker locks onto whichever body it noticed first and keeps chasing that one, and it is clamped to its own span even while chasing. TAKE 1: run right from spawn. w1 will come at you, so jump over it — you clear 3.6 units and it is only 1.3 tall — then climb the step at x=16..18.2 (a 1.8 rise) and up onto the perch at x=18.6..21 (a 2.4 rise). Stand there. w1 crowds up to its right bound near x=19 and stares, but it is a ground unit and cannot reach the perch, so you survive the take. TAKE 2: Echo A now holds w1 pinned at the RIGHT end of its span, which leaves the LEFT end clear. Walk to p1 at x=10 and stand on it — it is 9 units from the pinned walker, outside its 6.5 alert range. That opens the door at x=24. TAKE 3: Echo A pins w1, Echo B holds p1 and the door is open by about t=1.7s. Run right, pass the doorway at about t=2.6s, and you are into w2's territory. Nothing is left to bait it with, so handle w2 the other way: jump clean over it and drop into the exit at x=28. If it is walking toward you, wait a beat on the far side of the doorway and go as it turns.

dialogue.text: Two of them now. Different rooms, same patience.

dialogue.speaker: ECHO-0
dialogue.text: You only have two recordings. One goes to the first. The second you handle yourself.
